title: Before You Begin
intro: A few questions about your experience with AI assistants.

items.text: How often do you use AI chat assistants (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini)?
How often have you used AI agents to perform workspace tasks on your behalf (e.g., sending emails, scheduling events or managing files)?
items.description: AI agents are AI assistants capable of taking actions on a user's behalf.

items.text: How familiar are you with agentic tools and skills?
items.description: Tools enable AI agents to perform actions, while skills provide instructions that guide how agents perform tasks.
